description: This file defines core system functions for Keystone, including configuration, schema creation, and context setup.

methods.name: getBuiltKeystoneConfigurationPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the Keystone configuration file based on the current working directory.

methods.name: getInternalGraphQLSchema
methods.description: Creates an internal GraphQL schema with modifications to list fields for internal use.

methods.name: injectNewDefaults
methods.description: Extends the Prisma client to inject default values for fields with 'random' default types.

methods.name: formatUrl
methods.description: Formats database URLs, especially for SQLite to add connection limits.

methods.name: createSystem
methods.description: Initializes the Keystone system with configuration, schemas, and context setup functions.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Creates and returns a Keystone context based on configuration and Prisma module.
